TRAFFIC ADVISORY - A vehicle collision at Frederick Road and Croghen Lane has Frederick Road shut down in both directions before route 109. 
A car being towed on a trailer fell off the trailer and hit a second vehicle. 
Preliminarily, no reports of injuries or anyone transported. 
Drivers are advised to seek an alternate route and expect significant delays. 

#RoadClosure #MCPD #MCPNews
